summary: American Express Credit Account Master Trust filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus covering a $1.25 billion Series 2026-1 offering of fixed-rate asset-backed certificates. The Class A certificates price to public at 99.97894% ($1,249,736,750) with a 4.99% coupon, while $53,572,000 of subordinated Class B certificates carry a 5.39% rate. Expected final payment is September 17, 2029 and legal final maturity September 15, 2031. Barclays, Mizuho, RBC and Scotiabank are joint bookrunners. This is a routine credit-card ABS takedown, not a corporate special situation, so the risk-arb angle is limited to spread and subscription dynamics.
